# Grok Bot Skills

> Community-maintained, MIT-licensed Agent Skills for Grok bot workflows and skill-compatible AI assistants. Plain Markdown instructions, not an official xAI product or a hosted runtime.

## Overview
- Repository: https://github.com/ofershap/grok-bot-skills
- README: README.md
- Contribution guide: CONTRIBUTING.md
- Format: https://agentskills.io/specification

## Skill catalog
- Short answers: skills/short-answers/SKILL.md - concise, answer-first replies.
- Slack voice: skills/slack-voice/SKILL.md - draft messages using supplied voice examples; approval before sending.
- Distill need: skills/distill-need/SKILL.md - find the real need before building a proposed solution.
- Make it click: skills/make-it-click/SKILL.md - concrete explanations when a previous explanation failed.
- Monthly checkpoint: skills/monthly-checkpoint/SKILL.md - evidence-based keep/change/stop review of a habit or tool.


## Community-inspired skills
- Claim check: skills/claim-check/SKILL.md - Check a claim against dated evidence, not repetition.
- Assumption audit: skills/assumption-audit/SKILL.md - Test the question before answering it.
- Consensus map: skills/consensus-map/SKILL.md - Show the shape of disagreement without manufacturing consensus.
- Source audit: skills/source-audit/SKILL.md - Read laterally and follow a claim back to its evidence.
- Competitor compare: skills/competitor-compare/SKILL.md - Compare eligibility first, then comparable costs.
- Morning brief: skills/morning-brief/SKILL.md - Keep commitments, deadlines, and missing data separate.
- Research review: skills/research-review/SKILL.md - Review original evidence, not another assistant's confidence.
- Socratic practice: skills/socratic-practice/SKILL.md - Make the learner do the next useful piece of work.
- Reflection to action: skills/reflection-to-action/SKILL.md - Turn a specific experience into a small experiment.
- Rubric rewrite: skills/rubric-rewrite/SKILL.md - Define good before revising.
- Quote-grounded answer: skills/quote-grounded-answer/SKILL.md - Extract the evidence before synthesizing the answer.
- Root-cause debug: skills/root-cause-debug/SKILL.md - Reproduce, isolate, test, then verify.
- Code walkthrough: skills/code-walkthrough/SKILL.md - Follow a real flow through real source.
- Attribution ledger: SOURCES.md

## Installation and limits
- Install through a compatible Agent Skills loader, or use selected instructions manually as context.
- CLI: npx skills add ofershap/grok-bot-skills
- Grok-specific loaders have not been tested here; do not claim universal compatibility.
- Skills do not grant private account access, permission to send messages, or a scheduler.
- Contributions need review, synthetic examples, attribution, and privacy checks.
